children: Beamr announced ML-Safe lossless compression for RTMaps, enabling real-time, zero-loss reduction of 12-bit Bayer video at capture. Initial testing showed 47% size cuts on eight 8MP cameras, adding to its content-adaptive mode.
Opens AV raw camera workflows to compression, preserving bit-exact data where required.
Runs real time on in-vehicle GPU
Edge execution lowers storage and transfer bottlenecks without extra hardware.
If replicated at scale, nearly doubles logging capacity, cutting data costs.
Two-mode approach fits different AV pipeline stages, broadening adoption.
Integration with RTMaps ecosystem could speed commercial uptake.

This extends Beamr’s push from media into AV data infrastructure with a practical integration and early test metrics. Conversion into paid deployments with Intempora/dSPACE users and disclosed revenue impact would turn this into a larger catalyst.
Based on the original press release from Beamr Imaging Ltd. distributed by GlobeNewswire.
